Uz.bar_b_note: The big-eared fox with warm orange fur and a blue patterned harness reads at Palworld-class creature finish with a clear face and silhouette; the bare grey stage gives no Valheim-class light to add to it, and the busy blue pattern muddies the torso at small size.

Hf.bar_b_note: The white-fleeced, curl-horned ram matches the owner's Stormcapra bar in wool and horn finish; side A's unchanged hit react and upside-down, legs-up faint frames are what pull it down.

Xs.bar_b_note: The ram model carries it at owner-bar wool and horn quality; side B's twisted legs-up faint with dark underside showing is what sinks that side.

Iw.bar_b_note: A lone wall panel in a uniform grass carpet beside a flat-shaded grey low-poly boulder, under flat midday light with no haze or shafts, falls short of Palworld base-building density and Valheim-class atmosphere even when side A's timber frame, cap and stone footing read as built.

Ys.bar_b_note: Side B's bold black-and-yellow banding reads well standing but its faint frames rear the snake high into the air with the shadow far below, and side A's near-black mottled gold body sinks into the dark stage; in both, hit react matches standing.

Nz.bar_b_note: Side A's matte slate-and-tan feathering matches the Galecrest bar and the carrying flight reads; side B's near-white, over-bright plumage loses the feather read and looks plastic.

Ct.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with white hair and beard, a moss-green vest and scarf, and brown trousers fits the key art's settlement palette; his large-eyed, softer cartoon face sits a step away from the naturalistic creature style.

Qg.bar_b_note: The fox model reaches Palworld-class creature appeal in fur, ears and face; side A's airborne flinch and the busy blue harness pattern are what hold it back.

top_changes.change: Re-author hit react and faint poses so every creature flinches visibly with all feet planted and faints onto its side, face toward camera, settled on the stage: no airborne flinch (Uz B, Qg A), no unchanged hit react (Hf A, Xs B, Ys A/B), no legs-up twist (Hf A, Xs B) and no snake rearing into the air when fainted (Ys B).

Ship the timber-frame homestead wall with cap, diagonal brace, darker weathered plaster and separate stone footing (Iw A), give it real thickness, and replace the flat grey low-poly boulder and uniform grass carpet around it with grouped props and a grove edge.

Fix creature material values: keep Galecrest matte slate and tan (Nz A), not blown white; lift the snake's base value or banding contrast so it separates from the dark stage (Ys A); simplify the fox's blue harness pattern so the torso reads at 30% (Uz/Qg).
